name: product-team
description: A coordinated product team as 33 skills: 23 role perspectives, an 8-skill delivery pipeline, a router that picks the right role, squad or workflow, and a Project Point of Truth practice for durable product knowledge. Use when work needs a specific discipline's judgement, a coding task should run through scoped execution with gate checks, or the team needs to consult, capture, check, or review project facts, decisions, assumptions, constraints, and learning.
